newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: South Korean stock market closed for Labour Day.
newsitem.headline: South Korean stock market closed for Labour Day.

text.p: The South Korean stock market is closed on Thursday for Labour Day. The market will reopen on Friday.
The composite index fell 0.82 points to 703.23 on Wednesday as anticipation of an inflow of a large amount of foreign funds fizzled out, brokers said.
The foreign holding limit of Korean stocks will rise to 23 percent from 20 percent on Friday.
